entities.summary: Mamadou Mustafa Ndala was a Congolese military officer. He commanded the Congolese Army's 42nd Battalion Rapid Reaction Force, which was formed by Belgium, Angola, United States and China. Ndala rose to prominence following his battlefield victories and successes over the March 23 Movement (M23) rebel fighters during the M23 rebellion (2012–2013).
